agent_assessment: Backend implementation matches the plan: BrandingRule struct gained the 6 metadata fields (target_files, detailed_description, passing_example, failing_example, fix_instructions, severity_rationale) and all 5 rules are populated; GET /api/v1/standards returns the enriched payload; POST /api/v1/audit/evaluate/{scenario}?rule= filters to a single rule, returns 400 on unknown rule via apierr.Validation, and preserves all-rules behavior when omitted. The three planned backend regression tests (single-rule, unknown-rule-400, no-param-all-results) are present and pass. Frontend implementation matches the plan's UX shape: shared scenario input at top, per-rule expandable cards (multiple may be open), per-rule Check Scenario button, Scan All Rules button with X/N summary colored green/red/amber by severity, and ScannerPage continues to pass its existing 11 tests. ONE deliberate deviation from plan §6 Phase 2: instead of porting prompt-manager's react-markdown/remark-gfm/marked/shiki/@tailwindcss/typography stack, the implementer wrote a ~200-line in-house Markdown component (src/components/markdown.tsx) covering paragraphs, lists, fenced code blocks with copy button, inline code, and bold. No new npm deps, no Shiki highlighting, no `prose` class. Component docstring acknowledges the intent: rule docs are author-controlled Go strings, not user input, so a full markdown lib was treated as overkill. This is a scope reduction worth flagging — it satisfies the visible behavior (markdown renders correctly) but does not deliver the cross-scenario component reuse the plan called out.
notes: Markdown stack deviates from plan §6 Phase 2: in-house ~200-line parser instead of porting prompt-manager's react-markdown + shiki + @tailwindcss/typography. No new deps were added. Behavior works for the 5 hardcoded rules; richer markdown (tables, syntax highlighting, raw HTML) is not supported.

Backend tests are named TestEvaluateScenarioSingleRuleReturnsOneResult / TestEvaluateScenarioUnknownRuleReturns400 / TestEvaluateScenarioNoRuleParamReturnsAllResults — same intent as the snake_case names in the plan, just Go-idiomatic naming.
Implementation was applied directly to the working tree (non-sandbox execution); diff-summary shows 0 changed files, but the changes are present and uncommitted in the repo.
No live UI smoke test was performed (no browser-automation-studio capture); per plan §12 the operator is expected to do the manual scenario-restart smoke check.
